data.description:
Über uns

CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.

Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.

Deine Rolle

Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.

Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.

Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.

Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Backlog und Tickets

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

  • Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

  • Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

Konzeption

  • Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

  • Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

  • Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

Planung und Steuerung

  • Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

  • Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

  • Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

Schnittstellen

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

  • Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

  • Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

  • Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

  • Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

Deine ersten Monate

  • In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

  • Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

  • Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

  • Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

  • Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

  • Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.

  • Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.

  • Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit mit Impact: ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt, das Menschen schützt

  • Echte Verantwortung: du gestaltest die Produktarbeit bei uns von Grund auf

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: remote, hybrid oder in unserem Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • Faires Gesamtpaket: marktgerechtes Gehalt plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

  • Steuerfreie Benefits wie Essenszuschuss und Gutscheine

  • Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Offene und authentische Unternehmenskultur, geprägt durch Vertrauen, Respekt und Teamarbeit

  • Hochwertige Ausstattung mit Apple-Geräten

  • Gemeinsame Teamevents, wie unser jährliches Company-Retreat oder unsere Weihnachtsfeier

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch, etwa 30 Minuten

  2. Fachgespräch, etwa 60 Minuten

  3. Kleine Fallstudie, etwa zwei bis drei Stunden, die du uns anschließend vorstellst

  4. Gespräch mit beiden Gründer:innen

Nach jedem Schritt bekommst du zügig Rückmeldung von uns.

Hast du Lust, die Arbeitssicherheit mit uns auf das nächste Level zu bringen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

data.description:
You don't just want to analyze a business – you want to steer it. As Team Lead Pricing & AI (m/f/d), you own pricing and the AI roadmap for our Books & Media Business Unit and brands. You decide how we price what we buy and what we sell – and turn better pricing, smarter systems, and data-driven decisions into sustainable growth and profit.

Your mission

Pricing & business ownership

  • Own and shape the pricing strategy for buying and selling across momox, medimops, and momoxbooks
  • Drive gross margin and operating margin – with long-term profit as your north star
  • Balance pricing decisions with warehouse capacity and inventory quality
  • Define our price positioning in the buying and selling markets
  • Design, run and analyze pricing experiments
  • Model how pricing algorithms affect marketing efficiency and long-term customer behavior
  • Spot risks and opportunities early and steer them together with BU management – before others have to point them out
  • Act as sparring partner for BU management on profit-oriented steering

Product ownership – Pricing & AI Engineering

  • Take on the Product Owner role for our Pricing Engineering and AI Engineering teams
  • Build the roadmaps with Business, Data Science and Engineering – and prioritize by business impact
  • Drive topics such as an AI-supported dynamic pricing engine, buying and selling price logic, experimentation frameworks, pricing reporting, and price steering by brand, category and attribute
  • Identify the AI use cases with the highest value potential – e.g. sellability prediction, buy/no-buy decisions and market price definition
  • Make sure AI projects deliver measurable results in revenue, profitability, efficiency or customer experience – not research for its own sake
  • Translate between business and tech: you understand both the commercial impact and the technical feasibility

Leadership & collaboration

  • Lead your Pricing team functionally and disciplinarily: goals, priorities, coaching, feedback, development and hiring
  • Build a team culture of ownership, analytical thinking and high execution quality
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, AI/Data Science, Marketing, Logistics IT, Finance & Controlling and our Senior Management Team
  • Bring different interests together and make decisions that serve momox as a whole

Your profile

  • Several years of experience in pricing, revenue management, analytics or e-commerce
  • Very strong analytical skills – you're confident with data and KPI systems
  • Hands-on experience with experiments and A/B testing
  • You build and evaluate business cases and know what drives margin
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data teams – ideally as Product Owner or in a similar role
  • A solid understanding of machine learning and AI applications: you know what models can do – and where their limits are
  • Leadership skills: first experience leading people, or a proven track record of guiding teams, projects or cross-functional initiatives
  • Strong ownership and entrepreneurial thinking – you take initiative instead of waiting for direction
  • You make decisions quickly, also under uncertainty, and prioritize with a clear focus on impact
  • Structured, results-oriented, and resilient
  • Clear and direct communication
  • Fluent English (min. C1); German is a plus

You can look forward to

  • Flexible working hours: We follow a hybrid work model with 20 in-office days per quarter to foster important personal interaction while enabling a modern, flexible way of working. The remaining days can be worked from home, and you also have the option to spend up to 6 weeks per year working from countries within EU. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours to fit your individual needs.
  • Individual work environment: Design your ergonomic workspace just the way you like it – with height-adjustable desks and the laptop of your choice (MacBook or ThinkPad). If things get a bit noisy in the office, your Bose noise-cancelling headphones ensure uninterrupted focus. If needed, we can also provide you with an ergonomic chair or additional monitors for your home office.
  • Open work environment: We work together in a bright, open-plan office where even the few existing doors are always open. Our teams are motivated and open to new ideas. Bring your creativity to the table and make things happen! If you need a moment of peace, you can retreat to a cosy corner of the medimops library in the break room, or recharge with a game of foosball, table tennis, or PlayStation.
  • Training: momox is only as good as you. That's why you will find room and budget for your individual professional development with language classes, internal training, conferences, (online) courses and more.
  • Company discounts: As a momoxian, you can look forward to a monthly voucher for our momox fashion online shop, as well as medimops. Additionally, you benefit from numerous company discounts from our partners.
  • Sustainability: We love second-hand and incorporate our sustainable business idea into the office routine with simple methods like using eco-friendly supplies, double-sided printing, energy-saving modes on devices, waste separation, etc. In doing so, we take responsibility and integrate sustainability into all our activities.
  • Daily fresh fruit and vegetables: We provide fresh fruit, coffee, and Mate at the office, and thrice a week, you can order lunch from an online canteen. At the end of each month, we get together for a themed breakfast in the morning.
  • Reduced ticket for the public transport: Save real money with the Germany or Job Ticket for the Berlin S-Bahn.
  • Sport and fitness offers: During the week, you have the opportunity to take part in various sports activities. Whether it's online training, massages, or stretching at your desk – there's something for everyone. You can also get a discounted membership for Urban Sports Club or Wellhub.

data.description:
Since 2018, we’ve become one of Google’s largest CSS Premium Partners, powering Shopping ads for 1,000+ customers across 20,000+ Merchant Centres in Europe.

Fully self-funded, profitable and still expanding, we’re a strong and supportive team with a stable foundation. Now we’re looking for a new colleague who wants to be part of it for the long run: an engineer who gets a goal rather than a ticket, builds with AI as a natural part of the job, and takes ownership from idea to production.

Why adstrong

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere in the EU, with flexible hours and no weekend or night work.

  • No process chaos: documentation and procedures are well-structured and digital.

  • No politics: we encourage proactive decisions and make ours within 24 hours.

  • Stable and growing: a fully self-funded, fast-growing company with no external investors.

  • Small, skilled team: a hands-on tech team of around 6 people.

  • Great working culture: supportive colleagues who help each other and share knowledge openly.

  • AI-first: coding agents are how we build, and your judgement is what matters.

  • Attractive compensation: plus all the equipment you need.

  • Missing anything? Mention it in your application, and we’ll see if we can make it happen.

What you will do

  • Build AI-first: plan with AI, drive coding agents and review their output with a critical eye.

  • Get a goal, not a ticket: work directly with colleagues on the business side to gather requirements, align on the solution and build it into working software.

  • Make sound architecture and data-model decisions, keeping our systems fast and reliable as we scale.

  • Take ownership of existing applications and build new solutions for our affiliate business.

  • Design and develop event-driven backend systems that handle large volumes of product and campaign data, mostly in Rust and partly in Python.

  • Own your topics end to end and keep the team and stakeholders in the loop along the way.

What you bring

  • Experience contributing to a strong engineering culture, e.g. through code reviews, knowledge sharing, or improving team tools and ways of working.

  • Daily hands-on work with coding agents: you plan with AI, delegate the implementation and know how to review what comes back, including more complex workflows like one model writing code while another reviews it.

  • Strong architectural awareness: you know which components and infrastructure to use for which problem, and how to structure what you build.

  • Rust experience, or curiosity about it and readiness to make it your main language, as most of our backend is written in it. C or C++ experience is a strong alternative.

  • Experience solving problems close to ours, ideally in e-commerce, affiliate marketing, Google Shopping, Google Ads or other data-heavy web platforms. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • Experience with event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS or similar)

  • A solid grasp of the full engineering process: requirements, design, trade-offs, testing and maintainability

  • Mid- or senior-level experience. We care more about how you think and work than about years on paper. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

  • Business-fluent English (C1).

Our stack: Rust and some Python on the backend, TypeScript / Next.js on the frontend (handled by our frontend engineers, so it’s optional for you), plus AWS, SQL databases, Elasticsearch and GitLab. Familiarity with any of these is an advantage, but it’s not a checklist you need to match.

How you work

  • You communicate clearly and proactively. You’re comfortable talking to business colleagues, ask the right questions early, share progress without being asked and explain technical trade-offs in plain language.

  • You value good engineering culture. We improve as a team, so honest feedback matters to us, and so do your ideas for improving our team culture, tools and the way we work in IT.

  • You organize yourself. Give you a goal, and you’ll plan the work, set priorities and follow through, without needing a detailed ticket for every step.

  • You’re genuinely curious. You enjoy digging into new topics, including the business side, and you keep learning as tools and AI evolve.

  • You take ownership. You care about the outcome, not just the code, and you drive your topics forward instead of waiting for direction.

If you match most of these points and want to help shape the technology behind one of Europe’s leading CSS providers, we’d love to hear from you. There’s no classic coding test in our process. Instead, we’ll talk through a realistic goal together and see how you approach it with AI.

Apply now if you want stability without standing still: a place to learn, grow and stay.

Jobbeschreibung

Für den Maschinenraum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Digital Operations & Systems Manager (m/w/d).

Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit den Mitgliedsunternehmen treibt der Maschinenraum die Transformation der Organisationen durch das Teilen von Erfahrungen, Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Ressourcen systematisch voran. Der Maschinenraum ist eine neutrale Plattform vom Mittelstand für den Mittelstand mit inzwischen mehr als 70 Familienunternehmen.

Unser Netzwerk lebt von einer Systemlandschaft, die alle Maschinenraum Aktivitäten im Hintergrund trägt: Salesforce, Hivebrite, Zapier, Langdock und Google Workspace bilden das operative Rückgrat unserer täglichen Arbeit. Ein zentraler Baustein ist dabei unsere Maschinenraum Intelligence. Unsere Daten- und Wissensinfrastruktur, die Informationen aus verschiedenen Systemen zusammenführt, analysiert und für unsere Teams nutzbar macht.

Was du bewirkst

Du verantwortest unsere technische Systemlandschaft end-to-end und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung sowie eng mit allen Maschinenraum-Teams zusammen.

Du durchdringst unsere Prozesse fachlich, steuerst sie technisch und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit den Teams weiter. Das bedeutet konkret:

  • Tech Stack, Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du bist Owner unseres Tech Stacks mit “Work Smart” als Leitmotiv. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme Hand in Hand greifen. Du verknüpfst Tools, baust und betreust smarte Automatisierungen sowie Schnittstellen, hältst Prozesse schlank und erleichterst so den Alltag des gesamten Teams.
  • Daten, CRM & Reporting: Du nutzt Salesforce als unser zentrales CRM und als verlässliche Datengrundlage. Du verstehst Datenmodelle, verknüpfst Daten sauber miteinander und baust übersichtliche Dashboards auf, die dem gesamten Team als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen.
  • KI & Wissensmanagement: Du arbeitest explorativ an KI-Lösungen im Rahmen des Maschinenraum Angebots und entwickelst unsere aktuelle Intelligence-Initiative weiter. Dein Ziel: KI verantwortungsvoll einsetzen, um das Wissen in unserem Ökosystem optimal nutzbar zu machen.
  • Evaluation neuer Tools & Technologien: Du prüfst neue Lösungen auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für unsere Teams und begleitest deren Implementierung und Roll-Out. Dabei entwickelst du unseren Tech Stack kontinuierlich weiter.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bist du

Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem kleinen dynamischen Team, in dem jeder anpacken und mitdenken muss. Du hast Interesse an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Daten und Technologie und Freude daran, dich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Dinge praktisch umzusetzen. Außerdem bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Du hast idealerweise 3-5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem Startup-, Scale-up- oder vergleichbaren Umfeld, idealerweise in (Business) Operations, RevOps oder einer systemnahen Rolle.
  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte technische Affinität mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Systeme, Datenstrukturen und Tools einarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hands-on: Du übersetzt zwischen Fachbereich und System, treibst Themen selbstständig sowie strukturiert voran und bringst sie zu Ende.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Tools und Automatisierungen und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Systemen.
  • Du denkst ganzheitlich: Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Tools, Daten, Prozessen und Teams und kannst daraus pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Dashboards und Reporting-Strukturen und verstehst, wie Daten strukturiert und miteinander verknüpft sind.
  • Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und AI-Tools und hast Lust, dich eigenständig in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Neues auszuprobieren.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Ein Plus aber kein Muss: Erste Anknüpfungspunkte mit dem deutschen familiengeführten Mittelstand oder Community-Plattformen (z.B. Hivebrite).

Auch wenn du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, aber neugierig bist und Lust hast zu lernen, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.

Was dich erwartet

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Ownership: Viel Verantwortung und Freiraum, um unsere Systemlandschaft eigenständig zu gestalten, weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu prägen
  • Direkter Draht & kurze Wege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, direkter Austausch und schnelle Entscheidungen
  • Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten
  • Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung
  • Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs
  • Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. Sommerfest & Offsite), Teamtrainings und echtem Raum für persönliches Wachstum
  • Benefits & Auszeit: 30 Urlaubstage, freie Brückentage sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits (z. B. Urban Sports Club, BVG, Aware by Aeon)

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Über uns

Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern.

Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten.

Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden.

Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil.

Wir schätzen unsere Traditionen, sind offen für Innovationen und entwickeln uns weiter. Möchtest du mitgestalten?

Zur Stelle

Welche Anlagenstandorte eignen sich für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen? In unserem Projektteam mit fünf bis sechs Kollegen vergleichst du Alternativen und führst technische Anforderungen, Umweltbelange und raumplanerische Gesichtspunkte zu einer fundierten Bewertung zusammen. Damit schaffst du belastbare Grundlagen für Standortentscheidungen und wirkst an der Genehmigungsunterlage mit.

Du übernimmst fachliche Projektaufgaben und entsprechend deiner Erfahrung eigene Teilbereiche. Erfahrene Teammitglieder begleiten deine Einarbeitung und stehen dir als Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Deine Aufgaben

Du vergleichst und bewertest Standortalternativen eigenständig anhand fachlicher und rechtlicher Kriterien. Dabei identifizierst Du Konfliktlagen, bewertest Genehmigungshemmnisse und leitest belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen ab.

Du analysierst und beurteilst komplexe Planungsunterlagen, Fachbeiträge und Geodaten und führst umweltfachliche, raumplanerische, technische und rechtliche Erkenntnisse zu einer konsistenten Gesamtbewertung zusammen.

Du verfasst, strukturierst und prüfst anspruchsvolle Gutachtentexte. Deine Bewertungen, Abwägungen und Schlussfolgerungen begründest Du fachlich fundiert, präzise und nachvollziehbar.

Du beurteilst die Belastbarkeit von Quellen, Daten und fachlichen Argumentationen und stellst sicher, dass Aussagen zwischen unterschiedlichen Fachbeiträgen und über mehrere Prüfebenen hinweg konsistent sind.

Du identifizierst fachliche Widersprüche, methodische Schwächen und offene Fragestellungen, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und koordinierst erforderliche Klärungen mit internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und fachliche Teilbereiche, behältst Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation der Ergebnisse.

Das bringst Du mit

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Umwelt- oder Landschaftsplanung, Geografie, Raumplanung, Bau- oder Umweltingenieurwesen oder Jura, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse, Bewertung oder Begutachtung komplexer Planungs- und Genehmigungsfragen.

Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, umfangreiche und teilweise widersprüchliche Informationen zu strukturieren, kritisch zu bewerten und zu belastbaren Schlussfolgerungen zusammenzuführen.

Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in der fachlichen Textarbeit sowie Erfahrung darin, komplexe Sachverhalte und anspruchsvolle Abwägungen präzise, verständlich und überzeugend zu begründen.

Eine eigenständige, systematische und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit fachlichen Unsicherheiten, Datenlücken und unterschiedlichen Interessenlagen.

Souveräne Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Fragestellungen mit unterschiedlichen Disziplinen und Projektbeteiligten konstruktiv zu klären.

Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift - mindestens B1 Niveau

Das ist darüber hinaus von Vorteil

Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Planungs- und Umweltrecht sowie Erfahrung mit komplexen Genehmigungsverfahren.

Erfahrung mit Projekten im Bereich der Energieinfrastruktur und der Bewertung von Standortalternativen.

Sichere Anwendung von GIS und Erfahrung in der Auswertung und Interpretation räumlicher Daten.

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Koordination von Projektbeteiligten oder in der Qualitätssicherung von Gutachten und Fachbeiträgen.

Kenntnisse planungs- und umweltrechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen, Erfahrung mit Energieinfrastruktur sowie GIS-Kenntnisse.

Das bieten wir Dir

Eine unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit mit einer attraktiven Vergütung

Benefits – Jobticket und monatlich 50 Euro steuerfrei als Debit Card

Zusätzliche Absicherung durch eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung

Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersversorgung und zu Vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

Spannende, abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit echter gesellschaftlicher Wirkung

Ein motiviertes, wertschätzendes Team, das Wert auf vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Teamentwicklung legt

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit hochwertiger Ausstattung – inklusive höhenverstellbarer Schreibtische

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Zukunft

Gemeinsame Erlebnisse bei Firmen-Events

Du hast den Freiraum, dich einzubringen, zu gestalten und Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

So bewirbst du dich

Fühlst du dich angesprochen und konnten wir dein Interesse wecken?

Dann freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen und aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deines gewünschten Arbeitszeitumfangs, deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins über den Button auf dieser Seite.

Für fachliche Fragen steht dir Simone Ackermann (Standortleitung Büro Bonn) unter +49 228 / 8236 9890 zur Verfügung.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:

OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

  • Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

  • Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

  • Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.

MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

  • Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

  • Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

  • Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.

BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

  • Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

  • Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

  • Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.

TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

  • Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

  • Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

  • Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

  • 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

  • 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

  • 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

  • 🧭 Judgment on unattributable spend: You have built and defended investment cases for brand, community, content, or similar spend that will never attribute cleanly to a closed deal.

  • 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔄 PLG + SLG fluency: You have deep experience across both product-led and sales-led demand motions rather than primarily one.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer-focused environment: You have worked at a community-led, open-source, or developer-focused product company.

  • 🧪 Incrementality & experimentation: You have exposure to incrementality testing, holdout design, or marketing mix modeling.

  • 🛠️ Marketing & RevOps tooling: You have experience consuming data from tools such as HubSpot or Marketo, GA4, attribution platforms, and Salesforce.

  • 📋 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity, or multi-stakeholder environments.

  • 🧑‍🔬 Data self-sufficiency: You are comfortable using SQL and building your own views in tools such as Looker, Metabase, or Hex rather than waiting on a Data team.

  • ⚙️ Relevant SaaS domain experience: You have worked in workflow automation, developer tools, or infrastructure SaaS.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll own the financial view of one of the most important joins in our growth engine: where community, product-led adoption, and enterprise demand generation meet. You’ll work closely with Marketing leadership and counterpart FP&A Managers covering the PLG and SLG bottom of funnel, giving you visibility across the full commercial plan and real influence over how we allocate one of our largest discretionary investments.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where finance is expected to help shape decisions, not simply report on them. As n8n expands the opportunity around AI agent orchestration and helps businesses unlock measurable ROI through automation, you’ll help build the planning discipline, investment frameworks, and automation-first finance practices that support our next stage of growth.

data.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

At Mapbox, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) ensure successful, on-time launches for Mapbox's key customers by turning complex needs into realized value. TPMs independently develop and execute strategies to maximize customer satisfaction, while minimizing thrash in changes to priorities and roadmap. They provide high-judgement updates to Mapbox leaders–keeping them informed on progress while handling the day-to-day operations independently.

 

What You'll Do

Mapbox is seeking a Technical Program Manager III (TPM) to lead complex, high-visibility post-sales programs for our large automotive customers. This is a high-impact role in a dynamic environment where you will work both independently and collaboratively alongside a high-performing team of TPMs to deliver successful customer launches. You will drive operational rigor within your programs, acting as a key driver of accountability and consistent, high-quality delivery across cross-functional teams within Mapbox.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex automotive customer launches and programs, serving as the main point of contact for program health, timelines, and execution

  • Be the primary interface between our key automotive customers and our internal teams, advocating for mutual success by championing the needs of our customers with internal teams (including leadership, product management, engineering, sales, technical support), and representing Mapbox to our customers

  • Define success for our customer programs, including how we measure it, and how we get there.

  • Align with Product and Engineering to translate and prioritize customer feedback into actionable insights and roadmap clarity.

  • Set and uphold a high quality bar, working with technical support, product and engineering teams to ensure effective prioritization and resolution of quality issues, and to synthesize and address overarching quality concerns.

  • Lead senior-level discussions - both internally and externally - around delivery timelines, trade-offs, scope, and business impact.

  • Provide calm and decisive program leadership during high-pressure situations with customers.

  • Provide clear & concise reporting to program key stakeholders and track and manage and report on program risks, working with customers and internal teams to mitigate and/or and escalate for resolution.

  • Lead or contribute to internal initiatives to improve internal processes across the TPM and Mapbox organizations.

  • Develop a deep knowledge of Mapbox products and services in order to steer technical discussions and build trust with our customers

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise software implementations in a highly regulated post-sales or professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated success in the automotive industry managing scope, SOW execution, change management, and high-impact customer escalations.

  • Proven ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments from kickoff through production launch.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 20%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Delivery-Oriented Leader: You are accountable for outcomes and not just coordination. You build structure in ambiguity and create operational discipline that enables predictable success.

  • Customer-Centric Operator: You proactively represent the customer internally and ensure their business objectives drive implementation priorities.

  • Effective Communicator: You engage effectively across audiences from developers to senior executives with clarity, confidence, and precision.

  • Technically Fluent: You understand cloud architectures, API/SDK integrations, and enterprise technical ecosystems deeply enough to anticipate risk and guide execution credibly.

  • Cross-Functional Influencer: You navigate matrixed organizations effectively aligning Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Executive Leadership to deliver customer outcomes.

  • Knowledge of Automotive SPICE is desirable

Core Working Hours

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

  • Standby / On-Call: As needed with ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 30%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Hi there! We're seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Sales Commission to own the design, implementation, and governance of our enterprise sales compensation program. This senior-level individual contributor role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations and serves as the architect and steward of compensation strategy across our diverse go-to-market organization.

You'll partner with GTM Leadership, Finance, and People Operations to build world-class compensation programs that attract talent, drive the right behaviors, and align with business objectives. You'll manage the full lifecycle of compensation—from design through implementation, compliance, analytics, and continuous improvement—across Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Leaders, Partner Managers, Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers and other functions on variable compensation plans.

Note: This role focuses on compensation design and operations. Our Finance team manages commission accounting and invoice processing in Xactly.

What You Will Do

Compensation Strategy & Design

  • Own the strategic design of annual sales compensation programs for all eligible roles and adjust for market conditions, competitive landscape, and business priorities

  • Benchmark compensation against market data and peer software companies; conduct pay equity analysis and recommend adjustments to ensure competitiveness and fairness

  • Design commission structures, accelerators, quotas, and incentive mechanics that drive desired sales behaviors and align with revenue goals

  • Design and own SPIFF and other incentive programs outside of the official incentive plan

  • Lead cross-functional design reviews with Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to validate programs before launch

Program Implementation & Operations

  • Manage the end-to-end program launch calendar; coordinate cross-functional efforts and communicate timelines, changes, and deadlines to stakeholders

  • Build and maintain the primary source of truth for all compensation program documentation, including plan documents, commission schedules, quota assignments, and policy guidelines

  • Configure compensation programs in Xactly and SFDC; validate data integrity, test calculations, and ensure system configurations reflect approved plan design

  • Develop training materials and lead training sessions for sales teams on compensation plan mechanics, commission calculations, and incentive rules

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies across all geographies where we operate

  • Manage exceptions, disputes, and appeals related to commissions, quotas, and incentive payouts; work with VP RevOps, Finance and HR to resolve efficiently and fairly

  • Maintain audit trails and documentation for all material compensation decisions and changes

Analytics & Reporting

  • Build dashboards and reports to monitor role based performance metrics, compensation spend, payout distributions, plan attainment, and ROI on incentive investments. Including SPIFF reporting metrics

  • Conduct post-program analysis (win/loss, attainment distribution, program metrics) and deliver insights to leadership on plan effectiveness

  • Recommend program adjustments mid-year based on market shifts, business performance, and feedback from sales leaders

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with VP of RevOps to align compensation with business strategy and sales priorities; maintain regular feedback loops with Sales Leaders

  • Work directly with Commission Accounting on attainment data, payouts, calculations and discrepancies

  • Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and year-end reporting of incentive spend

  • Work with People Operations on equity, total rewards strategy, and talent retention initiatives

  • Communicate compensation strategy and changes to the broader organization with clarity and confidence

What You Will Bring to the Role

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation, incentive design, or related revenue operations roles (within software, SaaS, or enterprise sales environments preferred)

  • Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing compensation programs for multiple sales roles and structures

  • Advanced proficiency with sales compensation platforms (Xactly, Anaplan, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); strong data analysis and Excel skills

  • Deep understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and comfort configuring objects, fields, and reporting for incentive programs

  • Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfort translating complex compensation concepts for diverse audiences (sales teams, executives, finance, HR)

  • Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other employment law considerations affecting compensation (particularly for global organizations)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing compensation programs across multiple geographic regions with different regulatory requirements

  • Background in financial analysis, FP&A, or accounting; understanding of revenue recognition impacts on compensation timing

  • Exposure to Customer Success, Services, or other non-traditional sales comp models

  • Certification in compensation (e.g., WorldatWork CECP, GRP) or related HR disciplines

  • Experience at a high-growth or publicly traded software company

data.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, to orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, to generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Product is the only role that sees the whole thing

"If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.” - Henry Ford

Our FDEs go deeper into a single customer than anyone else at Atira. What nobody can see from inside one account is the shape that all the accounts share. You hold the version of the problem that is bigger than any single customer's description of it, and you break it into steps small enough to ship every month.

Then you defend it. Every deployment produces requests: A few are the next platform feature, most are a customer-specific detour that should never be touched. You are the person who cares the most about consolidating solutions and has the technical depth to do something about it, which means you decide what comes in and what does not.

As Atira scales we build industry-specific pods: FDE, AE, BDR and Product Marketer, led by a GTM Engineer. Pods go deep. Product goes wide. Everything a pod learns has to end up in one platform, and you are the reason it does. Make sure we do not chase faster horses.

What you will do

  • Own the problem, not the request. You understand which customer's ask is part of which bigger problem and you hold the maximum version of where this goes. Then you do the more challenging half: turning it into opinionated steps that ship, each one compounding into the next, so what we build becomes a staircase instead of a pile of features

  • Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core engineering team. You turn recurring patterns into features and you kill the rest. In an ideal world you are opinioonated on every FDE PR that touches shared code or introduces a customer-specific path

  • Build the agents that make Atira work. You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all its details. You extend our harness to solve the most complex job functions of our users: how to configure machines according to the engineering experts, how to price large service agreements for billion dollar infrastructure projects, or how to automate the multi-stakeholder internal communication. And you can translate that into code

  • Ship the platform end to end. Full-stack feature conceptualization and execution, from the harness through the UI a sales engineer actually uses

  • Collect Feedback in front of the users that ultimately are your sounding board

What we are looking for

Taste, ownership, and systems thinking. You can build almost anything now, which makes judgment about what to build the bottleneck. You see the problem behind the request, you decide in the absence of a brief, you say no to founders and to customers with reasoning that survives the room, and you own the outcome including the downside.

Your profile

  • Systems thinking, in both directions. Upward: you find the problem behind the request and can hold a version of it bigger than what any single customer describes. Downward: you see the second-order effects, that one per-customer config field means a migration on every future deployment and one more thing every FDE explains in onboarding.

  • Taste you can point at. You can show us things you have built and shipped that you are proud of, and a clear opinion on what you deliberately left out.

  • Deep software engineering fundamentals underneath a native use of agents. Strong Python, TypeScript or a related language. You judge and ship production-grade code, and you can review someone else's. Practical exposure to AI engineering (agents, harnesses, evals, RAG), deeper system design understanding or infra knowledge

  • Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a student initiative, an open-source project, a serious side build, or a role where you owned an outcome others would have delegated

  • You get excited by complex hardware. You can explain in your own words why an agentic sales engineer at an ETO manufacturer is a business worth building, and what Atira is trying to become

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe's and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners

  • Most importantly: collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function, but we will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like after a few months

  • Someone new can hear you describe what we are building and walk away with the same picture the founders have, plus a clear view of which step comes next

  • You have contributed your own thoughts to our general product vision and conceptualized a clear path forward to implement high prio features

  • You have shipped full-stack features and agents into production that are used across multiple accounts, and every one of them came from a request that showed up at more than one customer

  • The FDEs say the platform got easier to deploy, not harder

  • Your no's carry as much weight as your yes's, with the founders and with customers

GPS goes dark. Signals get jammed. Most drones fall out of the sky. Ours don't.

Soron Systems is building the navigation brain for autonomous drones that operate where GPS can't be trusted: contested airspace, indoor environments, and GPS denied zones. Born out of cutting edge research at TU Dresden, we've already flown our system under active jamming conditions and proven it works. Now we're going from prototype to product, and we need exceptional engineers to make it happen.

This is a rare chance to join at the ground floor of a deep tech startup solving one of the hardest problems in autonomous systems. You'll write code that flies (literally) and see it tested on real hardware within days, not quarters. If you're excited by computer vision, robotics, and building things that matter, keep reading. data.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) who can take ownership of complex mechanical designs from concept through detailed engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and validation.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, extensive practical design experience, and advanced SolidWorks capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of complex mechanical components, assemblies, and subsystems from concept through manufacturing, assembly, and validation

  • Develop robust mechanical designs for high-precision scientific and industrial equipment

  • Create and maintain high-quality SolidWorks parts, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation

  • Perform tolerance analysis and define appropriate fits, interfaces, geometric tolerances, and dimensional requirements

  • Translate system-level requirements into clear mechanical requirements, interfaces, and manufacturable design solutions

  • Define manufacturing requirements and work closely with suppliers and Procurement on manufacturability, materials, tolerances, and quality

  • Develop, test, and improve prototypes and actively contribute to design reviews and technical decision-making


Required skills:

  • BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Precision Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • Minimum 8 years of professional mechanical engineering experience

  • Advanced professional proficiency in SolidWorks is mandatory

  • Demonstrable experience designing complex mechanical assemblies, bespoke machinery, or technically demanding systems

  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, including manufacturing methods, materials, tolerance analysis, GD&T, DfM/DfA, structural design, and mechanical interface

  • Strong ownership of mechanical designs and technical decisions

We value:

  • CSWP – Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional certification

  • Experience in industries such as scientific instrumentation, semiconductor equipment, aerospace, precision engineering, special-purpose machinery, optics, or similar fields

  • Experience with high-precision systems and/or exposure to vacuum, cryogenic, thermal, optical, or vibration-sensitive applications

  • Excellent engineering judgment and the ability to identify and improve weak or risky design solutions

  • Practical understanding of how components are manufactured, assembled, tested, and serviced

 What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding particular achievements.

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules.

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development.

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being.

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus.

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications.

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices, and meeting rooms.

Wir entwickeln Automatisierungen, verbinden bestehende Systeme, erschließen neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für künstliche Intelligenz und schaffen Lösungen, die unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unseren Kunden die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern.
Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen Mix aus Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und klassischer Softwareentwicklung.
Als erfahrener Full-Stack Developer bringst du die technische Expertise mit, um unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du entwickelst selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt deine Teamkollegen dabei, technisch immer eigenständiger zu werden.

Das erwartet dich

  • Softwareentwicklung und Architektur: Du konzipierst und entwickelst eigenständig Anwendungen, Services, APIs und Integrationen – vom technischen Entwurf bis zum produktiven Betrieb.

  • Intelligente Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwickelst bestehende Automatisierungen weiter und setzt neue Lösungen um, beispielsweise mit n8n, APIs und individuell entwickelten Komponenten.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du integrierst KI-Modelle in bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst KI-gestützte Anwendungen und experimentierst mit neuen Technologien und Werkzeugen.

  • Systeme miteinander verbinden: Du sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Plattformen und Anwendungen zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren und Daten sicher ausgetauscht werden.

  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und achtest auf Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Qualität.

  • Wissen teilen und gemeinsam wachsen: Du unterstützt deine Kollegen bei technischen Herausforderungen, führst sie an professionelle Entwicklungspraktiken heran und etablierst gemeinsam mit ihnen nachhaltige Lösungen.

  • Eigenständig Lösungen schaffen: Du reduzierst technische Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Entwicklungsteams, indem du notwendige Komponenten selbst entwickelst und bestehende Schnittstellen sinnvoll nutzt.


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Umfeld.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen.

  • Erfahrung mit Backend-Technologien, APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme.

  • Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig umzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit Softwarequalität, Testing, Versionsverwaltung, CI/CD und dem Betrieb produktiver Anwendungen.

  • Interesse an KI-Technologien, LLMs, AI-assisted Development und Automatisierungsplattformen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch zu lösen und dabei auch langfristige Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten.

  • Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, andere zu befähigen und gemeinsam technische Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Freude daran hast, in einem Team mit unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen zu arbeiten.
Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und reichen von kleinen Automatisierungen bis zu komplexeren technischen Lösungen.

Damit beschäftigst du dich beispielsweise:

  • Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und Datenverarbeitung, beispielsweise rund um Vermittler- und Vertragsdaten.

  • Entwicklung und Erweiterung von Schnittstellen zwischen unserer Maklerplattform Professional Works und externen Anwendungen.

  • KI-gestützte Verarbeitung und Auswertung von Gesprächstranskripten, einschließlich automatisierter Zusammenfassungen und Coaching-Ansätzen.

  • Integration von Kommunikations-, Support- und Marketingplattformen in automatisierte Workflows.

  • Entwicklung interner Werkzeuge für Reporting, Datenanalyse und operative Prozesse.

  • Technische Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung unserer Automatisierungslandschaft..

Dabei entscheidest du gemeinsam mit dem Team, wann eine bestehende Automatisierungsplattform die beste Lösung ist und wann individuell entwickelte Software den größeren Mehrwert bietet.

Warum diese Rolle besonders ist

  • Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Entwicklungsteam, in dem ausschließlich Softwareentwickler sitzen und Tickets abarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, Automatisierungen entwickeln, KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und neue Ideen schnell ausprobieren.

  • Du ergänzt dieses Team um fundierte Softwareentwicklungs- und Architekturkompetenz.

  • Dein Erfolg zeigt sich deshalb nicht nur an dem Code, den du selbst schreibst, sondern auch daran, wie viel leistungsfähiger und eigenständiger das gesamte Team durch deine Arbeit wird.

  • Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Technologien mitzugestalten, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und unmittelbar zu erleben, welchen Unterschied deine Lösungen im Unternehmen machen.

Benefits

Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As an IT Security Engineer you own IT Security Operations at getolo end to end: running our detection and response capability day to day, keeping endpoints and infrastructure hardened, and driving incidents, vulnerabilities and findings to closure. Security operations is the core of this role. Beyond it, you bring an operator's perspective into how we design systems and into our governance work, to ensure control effectiveness.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Requirements

Your Mission

Security Operations - your primary function

  • Run and continuously improve our SIEM: log source onboarding, detection rules, tuning, alert quality
  • Automate orchestration and response with SOAR
  • Operate endpoint protection across our fleet
  • Triage and manage alerts, driving them to closure or escalation
  • Lead incident management from detection through containment, recovery and post-incident review
  • Detect and remediate configuration drift against hardening baselines; run technical audits
  • Oversee vulnerability management: scanning, prioritisation, and remediation tracking with IT and engineering
  • Plan and coordinate penetration tests (internal and with external providers) and drive remediation

Security Architecture - supporting

  • Contribute to security best practices and standards for infrastructure, endpoints, identity and SaaS
  • Bring security design input into new systems and projects early
  • Act as a security advisor to IT, engineering and the wider business

Security GRC - supporting

  • Feed operational reality into security policies, the risk register and control design
  • Support internal and external audits with evidence collection and remediation of findings
  • Contribute to security awareness trainings
  • Support third-party and vendor security assessments
  • Deliver operational input for management reporting on security posture, KPIs and incidents

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 4+ years in security operations, SOC, blue team or a comparable hands-on security role
  • Hands-on SIEM experience: onboarding sources, writing and tuning detections, running investigations
  • Knowledge of orchestration and response with SOAR
  • Solid experience with EDR and MDM-managed endpoint fleets (macOS and Windows)
  • Practical incident response experience and the composure to lead an incident
  • Vulnerability management from scanning through remediation, including pentest coordination
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001 or comparable frameworks (Grundschutz, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, DORA) and how controls map to daily operations
  • Scripting for automation (Python, PowerShell, Unix shell)
  • Clear communicator who can explain risk to non-security stakeholders and write for management
  • Experience with cloud first tech stacks running on SaaS and PaaS
  • Fluent English

What Would Make You Stand Out

  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CISSP or Security+
  • Cloud and identity security experience (e.g. Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, AWS or GCP)
  • Detection engineering or threat hunting background
  • Prior involvement in audits (ISO 27001, SOC2 or similar)

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
    • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
    • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
    • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions
    • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive


🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties 
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

 

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

 

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.
