Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Following our acquisition of the spend management platform, Perk is building a seamless, all-in-one solution for business travel and expenses. We are seeking an experienced, German-speaking Enterprise Account Manager to act as a strategic partner to our highest-value clients across the DACH region.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving client adoption, revenue retention, and expansion across our combined product suite. You will combine deep client empathy with data-driven consulting to establish yourself as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Lead and nurture a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building long-term relationships with key decision-makers and executive sponsors.

  • Portfolio Expansion: Systematically identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, particularly around our expanded spend management capabilities, to drive net revenue retention.

  • Executive Reviews: Deliver data-driven Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) to executive stakeholders, translating travel and spend analytics into clear ROI and actionable recommendations.

  • Product & Spend Expertise: Consult on platform best practices using complete mastery of the Perk product ecosystems.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of the customer, collaborating with Product, Support, and Onboarding teams to guide rollouts and influence product roadmaps.

  • Proactive Issue Resolution: Address complex operational or technical challenges early, establishing scalable solutions to ensure long-term retention.

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track Record: Proven success in Enterprise Account Management or Customer Success (SaaS, FinTech, or TravelTech preferred), with a history of consistently exceeding expansion and retention targets.

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to present to, negotiate with, and advise C-level executives.

  • Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex spend data into high-level business strategies that align client objectives with product capabilities.

  • Feedback-Driven & Collaborative: A low-ego, team-first approach that thrives on early feedback, rapid iteration, and cross-functional alignment.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win:

DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM

  • Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance.

  • Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics.

  • Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal.

  • Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow.

SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY

  • Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong.

  • Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen.

  • Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins.

BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION

  • Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution.

  • Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals.

  • Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy.

PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals.

  • 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection.

  • 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive.

  • 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals.

  • 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes.

  • 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback.

  • 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum.

  • 🇬🇧 UK location: You’re based in the UK and happy being on-site with customers once per week on average

  • 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English.

  • 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions.

  • 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion.

Nice-to-haves

  • Additional languages: You're fluent in French or Spanish.

  • 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories.

  • 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down.

  • 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution.

Why join us?
You’ll take a team of Enterprise AEs and turn it into a repeatable engine, in one of the fastest-growing open-source companies in Europe. The playbooks you build and the people you hire will shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest technical organizations. You’ll work directly with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product, so your voice carries well beyond your own team. n8n is a remote-first company with a passionate community of builders, a culture of autonomy and experimentation, and a very high bar for talent. If you want to build something that lasts while the company scales, apply now and help us make n8n the default way enterprises automate.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

Senior Finance Business Partner, UK Finance

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO.

You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. The role combines financial control, regulatory oversight, planning and commercial finance to support effective decision-making and sustainable performance.

This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee.

  • Lead the relationship between UK Finance and Group Finance, ensuring services meet UK regulatory and operational requirements.

  • Maintain independent oversight of the UK Bank’s financial position, constructively challenging and validating Group Finance outputs.

  • Lead UK financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting.

  • Partner with the UK leadership team on business cases, profitability and strategic decision-making.

  • Support the review of regulatory submissions and the preparation of Board and Executive Committee papers.

  • Monitor compliance with UK regulatory and prudential requirements, escalating risks and control weaknesses appropriately.

data.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

You’ll own a portfolio of Hiya’s largest enterprise customers across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for retention, renewals and expansion. As a trusted adviser to their senior leaders, you’ll prove the measurable value of Hiya Connect and grow each account over time. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product and Hiya’s leadership team.

You’ll need fluent English and business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, as you’ll manage many of your European accounts in those languages.

What You'll Do

  • Own 20–25 strategic enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe. You’ll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion.

  • Build executive relationships from Director to C-level, working across customer experience, contact centre, marketing, fraud, security and procurement.

  • Develop strategic account plans that map each customer’s objectives, success metrics, buying centres and whitespace into a clear growth roadmap.

  • Lead executive and quarterly business reviews that quantify return on investment (ROI), such as answer-rate uplift, contact-centre efficiency and fraud reduction, and agree next priorities.

  • Run complex renewals and multi-year negotiations covering pricing, contract structure, procurement, legal and security, and forecast them accurately in the CRM.

  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to find and close expansion across new business units, geographies, use cases and Hiya products.

  • Spot risk early through usage, health and relationship signals. Turn customer insight into clear input for Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What We Are Looking For

  • Typically 5+ years in customer success, strategic account management or enterprise account management at a B2B SaaS or technology company

  • Fluent English plus business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, with the confidence to lead executive conversations, renewals and commercial negotiations in that language

  • A track record of owning and growing large, complex enterprise accounts, including six- or seven-figure renewals and expansions against a net revenue retention (NRR) or quota target

  • Experience influencing senior executives and working through large organisations with many stakeholders

  • Strong commercial sense: you can build a value case, lead a negotiation and link product capabilities to a customer’s financial and operational outcomes

  • Experience creating and running strategic account plans and executive business reviews

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience managing enterprise customers in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, telecoms, utilities or healthcare, ideally across several European countries

  • A background in communications technology, CPaaS, contact-centre solutions, caller ID, fraud prevention or conversation intelligence

  • Working knowledge of UK and EU regulation on caller ID, spam and fraud

  • A record of turning customer feedback into product or go-to-market improvements

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. Checkout.com builds payment technology that helps ambitious businesses accept payments, get paid out, and grow into new markets. We work as one team, move with ownership, and look for better ways to help our merchants succeed.

About the Role

As the BDR Academy Lead, you will own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Checkout.com’s global Revenue Academy. You will turn commercial priorities into a structured, measurable development journey that helps Business Development Representatives (BDRs) build deep product knowledge, master prospecting skills, and apply our proprietary Sales Methodology. Your work will directly impact quality pipeline creation and prepare BDRs to progress into future commercial roles.

The Academy provides a consistent global foundation, tailored to two distinct sales motions: Mid-Tier and Enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the BDR Academy End-to-End

  • Partner with BDR and Commercial leadership to establish the Academy’s operating model, annual roadmap, governance, and continuous improvement cycle.

  • Manage the complete learner journey from onboarding to graduation, including cohort planning, communications, milestones, and learner support.

  • Build and maintain a unified global curriculum with clear applications for Mid-Tier and Enterprise motions, balancing global consistency with necessary regional adaptations.

  • Translate field needs into clear learning outcomes, facilitator guides, practical exercises, and reusable assets.

  • Coordinate cohort intake and operational readiness across regional BDR leaders, Sales, People, and Talent Acquisition teams.

  • Deliver learning efficiently using a blend of e-learning, virtual sessions, and in-person training (directly or via regional partners).

2. Drive Capability & Field Application

  • Facilitate engaging blended learning programs: live workshops, practice simulations, call reviews, coaching sessions, and on-the-job application.

  • Earn internal "Train-the-Trainer" certification for the Checkout.com proprietary Sales Methodology.

  • Build BDR expertise across payments, Checkout.com products, discovery and qualification, account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach strategies, and commercial tools (including approved AI tools).

  • Partner with managers to connect training to live BDR workflows, reinforce positive behaviors, and identify capability gaps early.

  • Act as an AI champion, supporting managers in embedding approved AI tools and automated workflows into BDR routines.

3. Maintain Standards, Certification & Progression

  • Define competency standards, rubric-based assessments, and clear certification requirements for the BDR pathway.

  • Lead evidence-based milestone reviews with managers and leaders at key stages (onboarding, probation, and progression gates).

  • Track completion rates, assessment results, and revenue impact; provide transparent data to help managers make informed progression decisions.

  • Prepare BDRs for future commercial roles (e.g., Sales, Account Management) while managing clear performance-based expectations.

4. Measure Impact & Collaborate Globally

  • Track and maintain an Academy Scorecard covering metrics such as onboarding speed, certification rates, pipeline contribution quality, and learner/manager feedback.

  • Analyze cohort performance by region and stage to resolve bottlenecks and optimize delivery.

  • Collaborate with regional teams to ensure local market relevance without compromising global standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear Pathways: BDRs follow a structured, tailored learning journey appropriate for their target market motion (Mid-Tier or Enterprise).

  • Actionable Learning: Coaching and training directly translate into improved live prospecting and pipeline generation.

  • Transparent Growth: Progression decisions are timely, objective, and grounded in clear competency evidence.

  • Measurable Value: Executive leadership receives clear, data-backed insights on cohort health, capability growth, and revenue contribution.

  • Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability.

What You Bring

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • Commercial & Enablement Background: Direct experience in BDR/SDR roles, BDR leadership, Revenue/Sales Enablement, or sales performance program management.

  • Program Architecture: Proven track record of designing, running, or scaling structured sales onboarding or development programs with clear milestones.

  • Instructional Design & Facilitation: Strong expertise in adult learning principles, workshop facilitation, and turning strategic concepts into practical, engaging training.

  • Stakeholder Management: Confidence collaborating with, influencing, and guiding frontline managers and senior commercial leaders.

  • Analytical & Operational Skills: Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics and feedback to evaluate programs and drive continuous improvement.

  • Tech & AI Positive: Comfortable using modern sales engagement platforms, learning technology, and approved AI tools to enhance productivity.

  • Proactive Leadership: Collaborative yet assertive approach—able to operate independently, take full ownership, and advocate for high standards.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or complex B2B technology sectors.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and sales engagement tools.

  • Experience building or administering skills assessments, certification programs, or analytics dashboards.

  • Fluency in additional languages relevant to Checkout.com’s key global markets.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region.

 

You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function.

 

We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

Your Impact

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

Application Areas

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

  • Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

  • Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

  • Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

  • Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

What You Will Do

Project leadership and delivery

  • Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

  • Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

  • Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

Science and campaigns

  • Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

  • Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

  • Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

Bridging experimental and computational teams

  • Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

  • Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

  • Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

Capability and product development

  • Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

  • Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows.

  • Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation.

  • A track record in one or more of the application areas above.

  • Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git).

  • Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them.

  • A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical)

  • Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors.

  • Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals.

  • Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level.

  • Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible.

  • Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment.

  • Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company.

Additional Considerations

These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

 

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

 

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.

  • Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information.

  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.

  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.

  • Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up.

  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.

  • Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning.

  • Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems.

  • Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively.

 

What you need to bring:

We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with:

  • 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline.

  • Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets.

  • Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records.

  • Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge.

  • Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations

  • Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes.

  • Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets

  • Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills

  • Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction.

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information

  • Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

 

What’s in it for you:

Come live the Lightspeed Experience…

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

 

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

 

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like

  • Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more.

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office

  • A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet.

As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities.

  • Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies.

  • Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work.

  • Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions.

  • Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail.

  • Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform.

  • A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach.

  • Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps.

  • Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication.

  • Reliable, stable deployments: Strengthen how teams handle model versions, integration issues, regressions, and recovery so that releases deliver value reliably.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in release management, software engineering, or a related field.

  • You understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning.

  • You have a conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals: what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version or checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than simply pass/fail.

  • You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as GitHub, Buildkite, and CLI tools.

  • You’re skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems and comfortable adapting processes and tooling as requirements, architecture, and timelines change.

  • You bring strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including when release trade-offs depend on limited or ambiguous data.

  • You communicate clearly with engineers and leadership, helping people understand priorities, risks, and decisions.

  • You’re pragmatic, methodical, and system-minded. You bring strong release-engineering instincts and are keen to develop the judgment to know where ML systems require a different approach.

It’s a bonus if you also bring:

  • Experience in AI/ML, autonomous vehicles, or robotics.

  • Familiarity with MLOps methodologies and tooling.

  • Experience with ML evaluation practices and tooling, especially for physical systems — including simulation, model leaderboards, and statistically powered experiments such as A/B or shadow-mode testing.

  • Awareness of model hardware and software dependencies.

  • A BSc or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Release Management & Cross Functional Collaboration)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Technical Assessment and Case Study)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

  • 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

  • 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve

  • ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

  • ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs

  • 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

  • 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform

You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.

Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.

You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI-first data quality engineering

  • Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.

  • Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.

  • Run data governance

  • Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.

  • Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.

  • Own reference and security master data

  • Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.

  • Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.

  • Expand coverage across the firm

  • Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:

  • trade signals

  • pre-trade analytics

  • client post-trade analysis

  • PMS analytics

Qualifications

  • A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.

  • A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.

  • Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.

  • Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.

  • A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.

  • Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.

  • Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

THE COMPANY:

Juul Labs's mission is to transition the world's billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We have the opportunity to address one of the world's most intractable challenges through a commitment to exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation. Backed by leading technology investors, we are committed to the same excellence when it comes to hiring great talent.

We are a diverse team that is united by this common purpose and we are hiring the world's best engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations experts, and customer service and business professionals. If the opportunity to build your career is compelling, read on for more details.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reporting to the Head of Field Sales, the Senior City Development Manager is the lead field operator for key strategic cities. Bringing strong commercial experience, this hands-on role combines city strategy, regional key account management, and specialist product knowledge to ensure field activity is tailored, scaled, and executed effectively. As well as taking primary ownership of their own city performance - driving awareness, distribution, trade execution, and market share - the role provides commercial coaching and practical support to City Development Managers across the region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Commercial Delivery & Strategic Customer Management

  • Account Management: Take ownership of regional key account operators and on-the-ground route-to-market partnerships. Build strong commercial relationships that drive long-term growth across distribution, execution, education, and rate-of-sale.
  • Commercial Coaching: Act as a commercial sounding board for City Development Managers. Offer practical advice, coaching, and support on account planning, negotiating, and working through local trade challenges.
  • Commercial Tools: Create, refine, and deploy practical commercial sales tools (e.g., commercial calculators, regional activity, customer and channel propositions) that address ground-level field challenges and help field teams and CDMs win across regions.
  • Regional Development: Build relationships and develop non-traditional trade channels, tailoring the approach to fit local market nuances while ensuring all partnerships align with company goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Execution Standards: Set the operational benchmark for distribution, brand visibility, and advocacy across all trade channels (including priority regional accounts, Wholesale, Vape, and alternative channels). Measure and evaluate execution quality across key cities, establishing clear guidelines and sharing proven approaches to help CDMs elevate standards across their own territories.

City Strategy & Execution

  • City Strategy: Adapt national frameworks into practical, city-specific plans that reflect local demographics, trade setups, and regional key account footprints. Identify what each specific city needs to win, ensuring resources are deployed effectively.
  • CDM Guidance: support CDMs in analysing their own cities, adapting national plans to fit their city's specific dynamics, and executing tailored activity efficiently. 
  • Third-Party Prioritisation: Work alongside and co-ordinate third-party field teams on a city-by-city basis, making sure field resources are directed to where the local opportunity is greatest.
  • Events & Activations: Identify and execute local promotional activity and trade programmes, designed specifically around the local target audience to drive engagement, product education, and sales.
  • Performance Ownership: drive city performance and manage risks and opportunities in your region
  • Field Insight & Strategy: Link field execution with the Head of Field Sales by translating plans into action, while feeding back trade realities, competitor moves, and new channel opportunities to shape national strategy.

YOUR PROFILE: Personal and Professional Qualifications

  • 3-5 years' experience in a similar role or commercial setting
  • Commercial Acumen & Account Management: Strong track record in account management alongside experience handling multi-site accounts that span across adjacent territories. Proven ability to negotiate, drive sales volume, distribution, and market share. Ability to adapt style to both existing and new channels and opportunities. 
  • Commercial Coaching & Regional Influence: Proven ability to influence and mentor peers by sharing commercial expertise, guiding regional key account negotiations, and helping tailor city plans, all while supporting established line-management structures.
  • Commercial Tools: Experience developing practical sales tools and toolkits to solve local trade challenges and drive regional growth.
  • Execution & Quality Evaluation: Skilled at turning ideas into reality by tailoring local activations, brand, and direct engagement opportunities to fit specific city needs. Proven ability to measure and evaluate sales return, and provide analysis to inform future execution standards
  • Commercial Analysis & Problem Solving: Skilled at analysing city sales data and trade trends to spot commercial gaps, fix underperforming territories, and feed clear market feedback to the Head of Field Sales.
  • Self-Driven & Resilient: Challenges the status quo, takes decisive action, and turns ideas into commercial results in changing environments. 
  • A full UK driving licence is required for this role. 
  • Education: BA/BS degree preferred but not required

JUUL LABS PERKS & BENEFITS: 

  • A place to grow your career. We'll help you set big goals - and exceed them

Our mission

Build and scale the logistics capabilities that enable Mistral AI to deploy, operate and expand high-density compute infrastructure reliably. Own the flow, custody, traceability and readiness of high-value hardware, critical spares and associated materials - from supplier dispatch through site receipt, storage, deployment, repair and end-of-life disposition. Deliver speed without compromising safety, inventory integrity, security or cost control.

Operating context & accountability

You will coordinate closely with Data Center Operations, IT Operations, deployment teams, Procurement, Finance, Security, Safety, colocation operators, carriers and OEM service partners. The role owns Mistral logistics processes and supplier performance.

Key responsibilities - deployment logistics and site readiness

  • Plan inbound and outbound movements for accelerator servers, racks, networking equipment, CDUs, replacement parts, tooling and deployment consumables across sites and staging locations.

  • Translate deployment schedules and bill-of-materials requirements into shipment plans, delivery windows, site receiving capacity, material availability and clear responsibility assignments.

  • Coordinate with business partners and site teams on loading bays, access approvals, delivery routes, floor loading, rack handling, lift plans, packaging removal, temporary storage and installation sequencing.

  • Identify logistics dependencies that could delay energization, commissioning, rack acceptance or compute availability; maintain escalation paths, contingency plans and recovery actions.

  • Create consistent procedures for goods receipt, inspection, damage recording, quarantine, staging, pick/pack, handover and proof of delivery, including exceptions and nonconformances.

  • Manage reverse logistics for defective equipment, repair exchanges, warranty returns, redeployments and end-of-life assets, with documented chain of custody and secure disposition.

Key responsibilities - inventory, spares and asset traceability

  • Define and maintain an accurate inventory and asset-control framework for Mistral-owned equipment, including serialized items, location, ownership, status, movement history and reconciliation with IT asset records.

  • Set and monitor critical spare-parts policies with IT Operations and OEM partners: minimum/maximum stock, lead times, failure demand, replenishment triggers, shelf-life and obsolescence exposure.

  • Establish auditable stock movements, cycle counts, physical inventories, discrepancy investigations and controls for high-value or sensitive components.

  • Monitor stock health, aging, availability, stranded inventory, shrinkage and repair turnaround; use evidence to optimize local versus regional stocking decisions.

  • Coordinate secure storage conditions, ESD-sensitive handling, environmental requirements, battery transport/storage rules where applicable, and restricted access to valuable hardware.

  • Develop common inventory taxonomy, operating procedures and system integrations to support growth across sites, providers and countries.

Key responsibilities - supplier, transport and commercial performance

  • Oversee third-party logistics providers, freight forwarders, warehouses, specialist rigging partners and couriers against agreed service levels, security controls and escalation requirements.

  • Work with Procurement and Legal on supplier selection, scopes of work, insurance, liability, transport terms and measurable performance expectations.

  • Coordinate cross-border shipping requirements with qualified customs and trade-compliance specialists, including import/export documentation, duties, restricted goods and relevant sanctions/export controls.

  • Monitor freight, warehousing, handling, repair and expedite costs; challenge avoidable spend while protecting deployment dates and service restoration capability.

  • Lead supplier performance reviews, delivery-failure investigations and corrective action follow-up; develop alternative routes and providers for critical supply chains.

  • Maintain reliable forecasting and reporting of expected arrivals, shortages, inventory exposure, blocked shipments, deployment readiness and outstanding returns.

Key responsibilities - safety, resilience and cross-functional execution

  • Partner with Safety and site teams to assess high-risk material handling, rack moves, lifting/rigging, traffic management and contractor interfaces; verify that required plans and competent resources are in place.

  • Coordinate physical-security requirements, access permissions, tamper evidence and chain of custody for sensitive or high-value technology.

  • Develop practical business-continuity plans for shipment disruption, customs holds, supplier shortages, loss or damage in transit, and urgent hardware replacement needs.

  • Work with IT Operations and OEM service partners to prioritize material flows during incidents and reduce mean time to restore affected compute capacity.

  • Create clear operating rhythms and decision records across engineering, deployment, site teams and suppliers; escalate risks early and close actions with evidence.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build, lead, and scale the team across regions, aligning organizational capabilities, staffing levels, and resources with Mistral AI’s growth trajectory and operational requirements.

  • Supervise, coordinate, and support team members, ensuring clear accountability, effective collaboration, and consistent execution of responsibilities.

  • Define the organizational structure, roles, responsibilities, and resource allocation required to support current operations and future expansion.
    Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing professionals, ensuring the team possesses the technical expertise and capabilities required to meet business objectives.

  • Establish clear performance expectations, measurable objectives, and development plans; conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching.

  • Drive standardization of processes, procedures, and best practices across regions while accommodating local operational and regulatory requirements.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence.
    Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to anticipate resource requirements, address organizational gaps, and ensure effective coordination across teams.

  • Develop succession plans and strengthen internal capabilities to support organizational resilience and long-term scalability.

  • Manage team priorities, workload distribution, and resource planning, ensuring effective execution while maintaining quality, safety, and operational efficiency.

What success looks like

  • Critical hardware and materials arrive complete, traceable, secure and ready for deployment when needed.

  • Inventory accuracy is consistently high, with timely reconciliation and documented custody for valuable assets.

  • Critical spare parts are available according to risk-based targets, reducing restoration delays and avoidable downtime.

  • Logistics exceptions, shipment damage, deployment blockers and supplier failures are identified early and resolved with measurable corrective actions.

  • Logistics processes scale across new sites without sacrificing safety, compliance, cost discipline or execution speed.

  • Working knowledge of transport, handling and workplace safety requirements; ability to engage relevant specialists on customs and international trade compliance.

  • Strong cross-functional communication, supplier management and problem-solving skills; professional English and willingness to travel to operational sites.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting data centers, AI/HPC infrastructure, hyperscale hardware deployments, enterprise IT logistics or complex industrial equipment.

  • Familiarity with serialized GPU/server assets, rack-scale systems, networking equipment, specialist lifting and ESD-sensitive components.

  • Experience implementing warehouse management, enterprise resource planning or IT asset-management systems and inventory dashboards.

  • Experience with international shipping, freight forwarding, customs interfaces, repair/RMA workflows and multi-site critical spares strategies.
