Notre entreprise

Depuis 2007, Kercia est pionnier dans les technologies de vote électronique pour les élections professionnelles. Basée à Grenoble et Paris, notre équipe de 63 personnes accompagne plus de 5 000 organisations —PME, ETI et Grands Groupes — pour simplifier, sécuriser et réenchanter leurs processus électoraux.

Kercia met à disposition une plateforme qui permet de gérer tous types d’élections avec des services adaptés à chaque organisation. Notre ambition : devenir le n°1 du vote électronique en France.

KERCIA appuie sa stratégie de croissance sur le développement d’un environnement qui permet à tous « Les KERCIENS » de bénéficier d’une expérience salarié positive, individuellement et collectivement.

Nous recherchons Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections désireux de s’investir dans la réussite des objectifs de notre entreprise.

En rejoignant la communauté des KERCIENS, tu participes à l’aventure d’une entreprise à taille humaine, qui saura t’accueillir avec bienveillance pour ce poste au sein du service opérationnel.

Ton poste et tes missions

Rattaché(e) au Manager opérationnel, tu assureras la réalisation de projets de vote électronique pour les clients en garantissant la tenue des délais, le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires et en optimisant la satisfaction du client.

Tu seras basé(e) à Meylan, aux pieds des montagnes dans un bâtiment neuf au 5ième et dernier étage. Ce sont des espaces lumineux et modernes, avec une vuepanoramique à 360° sur les montagnes. Pour te repérer : https://share.google/8RQ9qsOwmtwZ1evCw

Tu auras 3 jours/semaine possible de télétravail.

Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe de Chef(fe)s de projets, experte dans son domaine et passionnée par sa mission.

Tes missions principales seront :

D’assurer la réalisation des projets dans le respect des critères de qualité et dans un objectif de satisfaction client

- Organiser les réunions de lancement avec les clients :

- Proposer le planning établi en fonction des échéances du vote

- Valider les points juridiques clés

- Prendre en compte les attentes particulières du client

- Réaliser le paramétrage de l’outil de vote électronique en s’assurant de la validation par le client

- Piloter la réunion de scellement des urnes

- Superviser le déroulement des élections et intervenir en support de 2eme niveau en cas de sollicitation

- Animer la réunion de dépouillement des élections en rassurant sur la fiabilité du vote électronique

- Réaliser un bilan du projet et envoyer un questionnaire de satisfaction au client

- Organiser un point de débriefing avec le client pour les dossiers stratégiques

De garantir le respect des obligations juridiques ou règlementaires particulières au projet

- Recueillir auprès du client tous les documents d’entrée permettant d’évaluer les contraintes juridiques du client

- Rédiger et fournir au client les notes/fiches juridiques nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet

- Mettre en application les besoins juridiques du client (ex : échéances, sièges, quorum…)

- Conseiller sur leur adaptation aux spécificités du projet et attentes du client

- S’assurer de la prise en compte des règles juridiques (légales, conventionnelles) par le client tout au long du processus de vote

De contribuer à la sécurité de l’information dans le cadre de tes missions

  • Appliquer l’ensemble des politiques, procédures et bonnes pratiques de KERCIA en matière de sécurité de l’information dans tes activités de gestion de projets et de conseil juridique

  • Veiller à la confidentialité, à l’intégrité et à la disponibilité des informations traitées (données électorales, données clients, documents juridiques, contrats, etc.)

  • Signaler sans délai tout incident, suspicion d’incident ou non-conformité lié à la sécurité de l’information via les canaux internes prévus

  • Participer, le cas échéant, aux actions de sensibilisation et d’amélioration continue en matière de sécurité de l’information (retours d’expérience, contribution à la FAQ interne, mise à jour de supports, etc.)

Tu travailleras en synergie avec l’ensemble des services de KERCIA (commercial, technique, administratif, direction, …) et tu participeras à l’ensemble des ateliers et à la vie quotidienne de la communauté Kercienne. Tu génèreras de l’impact et de la satisfaction client au travers de tes missions.

À ton intégration, tu suivras un cursus de formation interne aux méthodologies et aux standards de qualité KERCIA. Dès ton arrivée et tout au long de ta prise de poste, tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe.

Partie intégrante du service opérationnel, le travail d’équipe et l’entraide sont au cœur des valeurs Kerciennes.

Ton profil

Tes atouts et toi

De formation supérieure bac+2 (BTS / DUT) à bac+3/4, tu as une forte appétence pour la gestion de projets et le conseil.

Tu as acquis une expérience de 2 à 3 ans en Gestion des Ressources Humaines / Gestion de Projets ou Gestion Juridique (alternance incluse).

Des connaissances en matière d’Elections Professionnelles seraient un plus et des compétences en matière de Relations Sociales / Gestion du Climat Social / Droit social sont recherchées pour répondre aux attentes du poste

Diplomate, tu possèdes un bon relationnel, tu es reconnu(e) pour ton aisance orale et rédactionnelle.

Tu es agile et autonome, doté(e) d’une bonne capacité d’organisation et de priorisation. Ton état d’esprit est orienté solutions.

Tu sais faire preuve d’empathie et de bienveillance. Ton esprit de camaraderie et tes idées folles sont attendus sur ce poste !

Bonus : ton appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et ta maitrise du PACK OFFICE seraient un plus pour répondre pleinement aux attentes du poste.

Mobile, tu seras amené(e) à te déplacer sur l’ensemble du territoire pour le compte de tes clients.

Poste à pourvoir en CDD 12 mois / prime qualité / tickets restaurant / intéressement / séminaire d’entreprise.

À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Votre intégration chez Kercia : Dès votre premier jour, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour que vous soyez accueilli dans les meilleures conditions : votre poste de travail (PC, bureau ect.) est prêt et configuré, et un « Pack Welcome » vous attend. Chez Kercia, l'onboarding est un véritable parcours de plusieurs semaines conçu pour vous intégrer naturellement à l'équipe et vous accompagner dans vos nouvelles missions au sein d'un environnement attentif à l'épanouissement de chacun.

Rémunération et avantages

Package salariale pour ce poste comprise entre EUR 25,000 et 34,000 par an (fixe et variable).

Vous bénéficiez de 25 jours de congés payés par an.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

AI is a key investment area for Kraken Technologies. A crucial part of this is building the shared foundations that let every team use AI well and move faster on our mission.

You'll work in AI Foundations. We build the platform that lets teams across Kraken build and run AI agents. Our work covers four areas:

  • Access: connecting people and systems to approved AI models and tools

  • Context: grounding AI in trusted Kraken knowledge, data and systems

  • Enablement: reusable building blocks for AI-powered workflows and products

  • Governance: permissions, safety, quality, cost and visibility across the lifecycle


🏡 Where you'll fit in
We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join one of our three squads:

  • Context: Build the Kraken-specific knowledge layer to make LLMs useful. This covers our internal AI assistant, a structured "client brain" that captures client context and decisions, and pipelines that collect knowledge from tools like Notion, Slack and GitHub.

  • Tooling: deliver LLMs into people's hands. We run the AI Hub (usage insights, MCP gateway, self-serve and specialist agents), the LiteLLM gateway behind Claude Code, Codex and Claude Desktop, and secure cloud dev boxes for AI-assisted engineering.

  • Evals & Observability: covers skill evals, internal benchmarking, agent safety and guardrails, and observability for live AI runs.

Squads are flexible: when priorities shift, people move. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. With your squad lead and the wider team, you'll own large parts of our platform, turn ideas into production systems, shape architecture decisions and help raise the engineering bar.

👾 What you'll own

  • Build shared AI platform services: Design, build and run Python services that other teams rely on, such as gateways, agent runtimes, knowledge pipelines and eval harnesses.

  • Build and run agents: Work out how agents are triggered, authenticated, monitored and governed across systems like Slack, GitHub, Notion and Asana. Ship both self-serve agents and specialist agents.

  • Ground AI in Kraken context: Collect, structure and serve company knowledge so agents give answers that are correct, current and safe to use.

  • Measure and prove quality: Define meaningful test cases, build evals whose results can be reproduced, and add tracing so we know how AI behaves in real use.

  • Build in safety and governance: Turn permissions, guardrails, budgets and data-access rules into software you can maintain, working with Security and TechOps.

  • Operate in AWS: Deploy and support services on AWS and Kubernetes, and make sound reliability, performance and cost trade-offs.

  • Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers and non-technical teams, run workshops, write clear docs and turn feedback into product.

  • Raise the engineering bar: Review designs and code, mentor others, and create patterns that can be reused across AI Foundations.


🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Strong senior-level software engineering: You have owned complex services end to end, from design through testing, deployment and operation.

  • Deep engineering fundamentals: Good judgement on system design, concurrency, security, testing and architecture trade-offs. Strong production Python.

  • Hands-on LLM and agent experience: You have built real things with LLMs, you know where they fail, and you use AI coding tools every day.

  • Cloud experience: You're comfortable running services in AWS and owning their reliability and scalability.

  • Product sense: You care whether people actually use what you build.

  • Clear communication: You can explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical people and challenge ideas constructively.

  • Learning agility: You pick up new tools and domains quickly in a field that changes every month.


🚀 What success looks like

  • Adoption: You ship platform features that teams across Kraken adopt and rely on.

  • Solid systems: The services you own are observable, secure, scalable and cost-aware.

  • Trust at scale: Teams can build and trust agents without rebuilding the basics.

  • Team impact: You make your squad, and the teams around it, better.


⭐️ Bonus points:

  • AI engineering: Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, LangChain, MCP servers

  • Knowledge and retrieval: RAG, search, embeddings, knowledge graphs

  • Evals and safety: Inspect AI, Ragas, OpenAI Evals, NeMo Guardrails, red teaming

  • Platform: Kubernetes, sandboxed or cloud dev environments, AWS Bedrock

  • Backend: Django

Do you enjoy working across the full IoT stack? In this role you’ll design embedded firmware for low-power devices, connect them through BLE, LoRa or Cellular, and build the cloud architecture and fleet management systems that run them at scale.

You’ll work closely with firmware, hardware and cloud colleagues, shape our CI/CD pipelines, and help improve how we build and deploy as we grow. It’s a hands-on role for someone who likes variety and wants to see their work running in real shipments.

📍 Location: We need you to be within commutable distance to Basel given the role requires 50%+ time spent on-site.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal)

  • Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular

  • Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments

  • Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations

  • Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions)

  • Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams

  • Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers

  • Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices


What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART)

  • Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON)

  • Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

  • Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

  • Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

  • Good written and spoken German and English

If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking an Office Manager for our beautiful Zurich office to create exceptional in‑office experiences that help teams connect and collaborate. As a member of the Global Workplace Experience team, you’ll drive daily operations, first impressions for new hires, and engaging on‑site events, shaping the small moments that boost engagement and productivity. If you love a fast-paced environment and running smooth, welcoming workplace environments and making meaningful impact on people experience, this role is for you.

This is a part-time role (24 hours) in our Zurich office

Please submit your CV in English

In this role, you will:

  • Create a positive, inclusive workplace: greet employees, visitors, candidates and vendors; build relationships to understand needs and improve experience.

  • Run daily office operations: perform daily walkthroughs, maintain shared spaces, manage furniture/equipment upkeep and cleanliness.

  • Manage budgets, supplies & vendors: coordinate purchasing, inventory, vendor contracts, service coordination, and invoice

  • processing.

  • Set up and handle beverages, snacks, and lunches

  • Work closely with the Social Committee to set up micro events, happy hours and events from concept to teardown.

  • Facilities & IT partnership: coordinate with Real Estate on maintenance, lease/contract matters and with IT on onsite AV and tech needs.

  • Help onboard new hires (office tours, local health & safety)

  • Drive local communication on Slack, intranet and info screens

  • Organize office documentation and storage, support global Workplace Experience initiatives, reporting, ad‑hoc projects and admin tasks.

  • This position reports to the Team Lead in Workplace Experience, based in Berlin.

Please apply if you:

  • Are a proactive, highly organized multitasker who anticipates needs and prioritizes effectively.

  • Have a people‑first mindset with excellent interpersonal skills, friendly, professional, and service-oriented.

  • Proven office/operations experience in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Solution-oriented and strong verbal and written communication.

  • Hands-on and strong time management and organizational skills

  • Comfortable working onsite

  • Proficient with Google Workspace especially Google Sheets and Slack

  • Experience coordinating events, catering and vendor relationships

  • Familiarity with facilities and renovation coordination.

  • Available to work in the office

  • Swiss German and German speaker fluency with excellent English skills (must have)

Benefits & Perks

  • 5 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Social events & Thursday happy hours

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Supplemental accident insurance

  • Health insurance subsidy of 250 CHF per month

  • Lunch Check Card of 180 CHF per month

  • Profawo membership which is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting the compatibility of family and work

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

data.description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing

  • Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
  • Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
  • Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
  • Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
  • Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
  • Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
  • Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
  • Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
  • A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
  • Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
  • Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
  • A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
  • Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
  • Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

  • Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
  • A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
  • Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

data.description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

  • Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

  • Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

  • Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets.

  • Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection.

  • Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team.

  • Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels.

  • Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

  • Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

  • Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

  • Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

  • Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

  • The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

  • Human-in-the-loop labelling tools and workflows.

  • Pipeline Orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and data versioning (e.g. DVC, lakeFS).

Your job

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

 

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

  • low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

  • context-switch-free code

  • design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

  • data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

  • complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

  • re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

 

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

 

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.


Who are you

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

  • extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

  • an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write

  • understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

  • knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

  • understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

  • ability to work with debuggers and profilers

  • operative coding (git, documentation)

  • ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

  • pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

  • experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations

  • experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases


What we offer

  • Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)

  • Fun and inspiring work environment

  • Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

  • 25 vacation days

  • Additional benefits: going out for dinner regularly, Friday afternoon drinks, yearly office trip(s), weekly massages, monthly meal allowance

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

  • Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
  • Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
  • Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.
  • Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés.
  • Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture.
  • Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif.
  • Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents.
  • Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
  • Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.


Profil :

  • Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines.
  • Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire, obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration.
  • Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire.
  • Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales.
  • Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.
  • Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers.
  • Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH.
  • Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles.
  • Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout.
  • Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive.


Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ?

  • Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain, au cœur de la vie de la Maison.
  • L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours.

  • Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève.
  • La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage.


Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison.

data.description:
Was bluu bewegt

Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen.
Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.

Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich.
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

  • Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

  • Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

  • Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

  • E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle.
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

  • neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

  • Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

  • neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

  • nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

  • Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

  • Du filmst und schneidest selbst, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

  • erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

  • Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

  • Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

  • echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

  • ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

  • Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

  • ein Büro mitten in Zürich, Homeoffice bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche

  • bis zu zwei Wochen pro Jahr arbeitest du, von wo du möchtest

  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem ganzen Team, auch bei neuen Produktideen

  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen: Wenn etwas Sinn macht, probieren wir es aus

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten)
Erzähl uns:

  1. was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

  2. Warum genau du perfekt für die Stelle passt

  3. wo du aktuell den grössten Hebel für bluu siehst

  4. eine konkrete Content-Idee für @bluuwash

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

Wichtig: Verlinke dein Video oder dein Portfolio direkt in deinem CV, zum Beispiel über YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive oder deine eigene Website.

Wir suchen keine Person, die Content nur plant.
Wir suchen jemanden, der einen Trend morgens sieht, ihn am Nachmittag umsetzt und am nächsten Tag weiss, ob er funktioniert hat.

data.description:
Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

  • Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

  • Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

  • Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

  • Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

  • Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

  • Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

  • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

  • Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

  • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

  • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

  • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

  • Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

  • Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

  • The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

  • Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

  • Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

  • Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

  • Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

  • A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

  • Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

  • Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

  • Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

  • Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

  • Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

  • Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

  • Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

  • Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

  • Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

  • Profile review and short phone screen

  • Take-home case study

  • Case discussion with the ML team

  • On-site interview and team evaluation

Responsibilities & Areas of Expertise

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind A1.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Track key initiatives and ensure actions are completed on time.

  • Experience in business operations, strategic operations, founder's office, or similar roles.

  • Able to identify problems, make decisions, and drive execution independently.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
  • Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
  • A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing?

We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing.

Wat ga je doen?

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen.

Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals:

  • Vormgeving;

  • Webinarproducties;

  • Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud;

  • E-mail marketing; 

  • Social media; 

  • Deep dive in de analytics;

  • Meedenken in plannen rondom AI.

Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan.

Met wie werk je samen?
Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren.

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

 

•            Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren

•            Mandaat en vrijheid

•            Locatie: Amersfoort

•            Uren: 32–40 uur

•            Opleidingsniveau: Hbo

•            Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

Motivatie; je optimaliseert wordt blij van groei. En wordt blij van resultaat en je vindt de marketing puzzel leuk en enthousiasmeert je collega’s voor jouw vak en de impact die je maakt.

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk

Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal.

Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • verhalen en ontwikkelingen ophalen bij collega’s uit verschillende delen van de organisatie;

  • helpen bij het plannen, voorbereiden en publiceren van content (tekst, video, offline materialen);

  • ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom grote interne bijeenkomsten;

  • nieuwe formats en creatieve manieren bedenken om verhalen binnen Voortman te vertellen;

  • kijken hoe we sterke interne content slim kunnen doorvertalen naar externe middelen voor bijvoorbeeld employer branding;

Je doet dit natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met het communicatieteam en onze collega’s van Marketing. Binnen het bredere team zijn verschillende specialisten aanwezig, onder andere op het gebied van foto, video en contentcreatie. Daardoor krijg je de kans om met verschillende disciplines samen te werken én veel kanten van het communicatievak te ontdekken.

Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

Zoetermeer of Breda
